task.description:
Run the focused SCH-04 validation suite and write a structured test report.

Validation scope:
- Execute the relevant build/test commands needed to verify SCH-04, including the new scheduler integration coverage.
- Confirm the SCH-04 acceptance criteria are covered by executable passing tests and document any infrastructure constraints separately from code defects.
- Write the test report under tests/reports/.

Expected checks:
- zig build
- zig build test
- any focused SCH-04 integration command needed in this repo to validate the new escalation timer behavior

Use the current local DB/test environment if required and available, and classify issues by severity if anything fails.

- WF03-sch04-fix-20260523 resolved the scheduler compile blocker and validated the focused SCH-04 integration path.
- Re-run the same focused SCH-04 validation slice and produce the updated report.
acceptance_criteria: Focused SCH-04 validation commands are executed
